messages:
emily: Quick RFC follow-up: want to land a small doc for staged onboarding failure-modes + compact fingerprint schema so runtime can route around bad KV behavior. High level: fail-fast lanes, reproduceable seeds, and a flat kv_fingerprint that is easy to store.

vikram: good. what's in the fingerprint? needs to be small and comparable.

emily: propose kv_fingerprint = [latency_ratio, p95_ms, kv_miss_rate, quality_delta]. Four numbers, stored on the model metadata and time-series sampled at ingest.

ben: how do we handle minor patch uploads? we shouldn't re-run full cache-smoke for every tiny change.

emily: rule: run full cache-smoke on major checkpoints or when weight checksum changes beyond threshold. Minor patches get fast-lite + delta compare with kv_fingerprint. If delta exceeds gate -> enqueue full smoke.

jia: sampling plan? deterministic seeds + small live reservoir?

emily: yes. 70% fixed golden seeds (to exercise hot KV paths), 30% reservoir from anonymized recent traffic. Target ~100-400 sequences depending on model size, cap tokens to a tenant-configurable budget.

vikram: intake needs to enforce budgets and return a flat outcome. Sketching intake output: {artifact_id, lane, outcome, kv_fingerprint, sample_tag}. Flat, easy to parse.

ben: what about quant variants? run fingerprint on FP32 canonical + default quant profile. Other quant variants get delta-check.

emily: for rollout, we have staged windows: canary 1% for 48h -> 10% for 24h -> full. Telemetry checks at each step look at kv_fingerprint trend and runtime p95. Auto-rollback if p95 > baseline*2 or kv_miss_rate jump > 0.05.

jia: retention and reproducibility: store sample_tag to allow replaying the seed set. Keep full traces for 14d, kv_fingerprint history for 2y.

vikram: I'll add a feature flag "staged_onboard_v1" and a small intake schema to enforce token caps and lanes. Ben can prototype the sampler and cost sim.

ben: will do. i'll also add an opt to skip reservoir for very small models to save cost.

onboard-bot: Ticket ML-ONB-4501 created: "Staged-onboard failure modes + kv_fingerprint schema" (assignee: emily).

sara: next steps: emily finalizes fingerprint defs + delta thresholds, vikram drafts intake schema PR, ben prototypes sampler, jia writes a short runbook for reproducing failures. Sync Wed 11am.

emily: thanks all :thumbsup:
